visual.general_description: Composite figure of three labeled panels: A a photograph of an agar plate surface with trails, B a micrograph of a larva, C an inset micrograph of a larval end.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A (photograph, left) shows brown material with pale trails on an amber surface. Panel B (large micrograph, right) shows a single elongated tapered larva running diagonally. Panel C (inset, lower center) shows the pointed end of a larva. Panel labels A, B and C are printed in white serif letters.

panels.general_description: Color photograph of an agar plate surface with brown material at left and thin pale tracks and dark curved shapes.
panels.detailed_description: Color photograph with a dark rounded vignette at the lower left corner. Brown, mottled, textured material occupies the left half, with pale whitish-gray clumps in the center-left and a small blue object at the lower left edge. Over the translucent amber surface at the center and right there are thin pale hair-like trails and a few dark curved elongated shapes near the top center. The printed label A in white serif type is at the top right of the panel. No scale bar is visible.

A smaller inset panel labeled C overlaps the lower left of the image. No scale bar is visible.
